items.headline: Doncic Delivers 42 as Wembanyama, Tatum Named Players of the Week
items.summary: Luka Doncic exploded for 42 points, 7 rebounds, and 13 assists in the Lakers' dominant 138-117 win over the Heat last night. Meanwhile, Victor Wembanyama of the San Antonio Spurs and Jayson Tatum of the Boston Celtics have been crowned the Western and Eastern Conference Players of the Week, respectively, for Week 2 (October 26 – November 1) of the 2026-27 season.

items.headline: Lakers Sale Finalized, Austin Reaves Re-Signs
items.summary: The sale of the Los Angeles Lakers has been finalized for $12.5 billion. In related news, guard Austin Reaves has re-signed with the Lakers on a new four-year, $185 million deal.

items.headline: Thunder Dominate Pelicans
items.summary: The Oklahoma City Thunder routed the New Orleans Pelicans with a commanding 137-106 victory. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander led the charge for OKC with 43 points.

items.headline: Lakers Cruise Past Heat
items.summary: Luka Doncic's incredible 42-point, 13-assist, 7-rebound performance propelled the Los Angeles Lakers to a 138-117 win over the Miami Heat. Austin Reaves added 27 points for LAL, while Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 30 for MIA.

items.headline: Rockets Upset Celtics
items.summary: The Houston Rockets pulled off a surprise victory against the Boston Celtics, winning 109-93.

items.headline: Trail Blazers Edge Nuggets
items.summary: The Portland Trail Blazers defeated the Denver Nuggets 118-110, extending their road winning streak. Deni Avdija was a key contributor for Portland.

items.headline: Spurs Dominate Jazz
items.summary: The San Antonio Spurs secured their fifth consecutive win, overwhelming the Utah Jazz 119-97. Dylan Harper led the Spurs with 17 points.

items.headline: 76ers Beat Bulls
items.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers earned a solid 126-107 victory over the Chicago Bulls.

items.headline: Knicks Top Nets
items.summary: The New York Knicks defeated the Brooklyn Nets 103-90 in a local rivalry matchup.

items.headline: Hawks Defeat Pacers
items.summary: The Atlanta Hawks overcame the Indiana Pacers with a 108-104 win. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 34 points for the Hawks.

items.headline: Luka Doncic's Masterclass
items.summary: Luka Doncic put on a spectacular show with 42 points, 13 assists, and 7 rebounds in the Lakers' win over the Heat. He is currently leading the league in PPG with 45.0.

items.headline: SGA's Scoring Explosion
items.summary: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander poured in 43 points along with 8 assists and 3 rebounds, leading the OKC Thunder to victory.

items.headline: Deni Avdija Leads Blazers
items.summary: Israeli forward Deni Avdija contributed 28 points, including 9 in the crucial fourth quarter, helping the Portland Trail Blazers defeat the Denver Nuggets.

items.headline: Nickeil Alexander-Walker's Big Night
items.summary: Nickeil Alexander-Walker delivered a strong performance with 34 points, 4 rebounds, 4 assists, and 4 steals for the Atlanta Hawks against the Indiana Pacers.

items.headline: Houston Rockets Soar to Top in Week 3 Power Rankings
items.summary: Entering Week 3 of the 2026-27 NBA season, the Houston Rockets have surged to the top of power rankings with a 6-1 record. The Philadelphia 76ers (7-1) also hold a dominant position, while teams like the Utah Jazz and Miami Heat are off to surprisingly slow starts.

items.headline: 76ers Lead Eastern Conference
items.summary: As of November 3, 2026, the Philadelphia 76ers sit atop the Eastern Conference standings with a 7-1 record. They are followed by the Detroit Pistons (6-1) and Boston Celtics (5-2).

items.headline: Western Conference Race Tightens
items.summary: In the Western Conference, the Houston Rockets (6-1) and Memphis Grizzlies (6-0) are leading the pack early in the season. The Los Angeles Lakers are also off to a strong start with a 5-2 record.
